brief:
Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman Nasser Urakji rejected statements by Donald Trump regarding Israel, saying regional populations have grown weary of Israeli deception, the Ma'an news agency reported. Urakji's remarks came as a response to Trump's recent comments on Middle Eastern affairs and Israeli policy.

The Iranian official's statement reflects Tehran's ongoing criticism of U.S. support for Israel and broader disagreements over regional geopolitics and the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.
title: Iran's Urakji rebukes Trump over Israel deceptions
